name: Oct Ring
description: Clean-room FAUST Hellektro Octave/Ring-Mod Fuzz: full-wave rectifier octave gnarl, internal carrier ring modulator, and 4x oversampled gated velcro fuzz.

params.name: Ring
params.explanation: Internal sine-carrier Ring Modulator depth (0 = pure octave fuzz, 100 = full robotic ring).

params.name: Freq
params.explanation: Ring Mod carrier frequency (40 Hz demonic growl -> 1200 Hz metallic shriek).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Parallel dry/wet blend (60-85 keeps vocals intelligible while ripping).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).
